source_title: Oversee Targets Leisure Travel Market with AI Technology that Cuts Servicing Times and Boosts Margins - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Travel AI specialist expands beyond corporate travel, bringing agentic AI and booking optimisation technology to leisure agencies and OTAs to cut costs, boost margins and streamline operations
LONDON , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Oversee , a leading travel technology company specialising in AI solutions for travel agencies, today announces the expansion of its full technology suite into the leisure travel market, enabling travel agencies and online travel agencies (OTAs) to automate complex servicing tasks, reduce operational costs and generate additional revenue opportunities from existing bookings.
The strategic expansion follows growing demand from leisure travel providers for AI-powered solutions capable of tackling rising servicing costs, increasing operational efficiency, and meeting evolving customer expectations.
At the heart of the offering is AgentSee, Oversee's agentic AI solution. AgentSee interprets traveller requests, researches options and completes actions including air and hotel bookings, exchanges and cancellations, searching for the most competitive available fares and rates along the way. On selected workflows it cuts servicing time by 50-90%, so agencies can handle more bookings, respond to customers faster and give agents more time for sales and customer service.
Alongside AgentSee, Oversee is bringing its established FareSaver and HotelSaver solutions to the leisure sector, helping agencies unlock additional margin opportunities from bookings already made.
FareSaver automatically identifies lower fares on existing flight bookings, uncovering extra revenue opportunities, with average revenue captured exceeding $200 per optimised booking. By securing lower fares on a like-for-like basis, agencies can improve margins and profitability.
HotelSaver applies the same approach to accommodation, continuously monitoring existing hotel reservations for lower rates and identifying extra revenue potential on more than 10% of bookings. This enables agencies to secure more competitive rates while maintaining the same booking conditions and avoiding disruption to travel plans.
Together, the three solutions combine intelligent automation with continuous booking optimisation, helping leisure travel businesses reduce manual workloads, improve margins and deliver greater value to customers without proportionately increasing headcount.
Aviel Siman-Tov, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Founder at Oversee, said : " Leisure travel agencies are under pressure to deliver faster service, more competitive prices and better customer experiences, often without the resources to grow their teams. Yet too much valuable agent time is still spent on manual processes that technology can now handle.
"AI is already fundamentally changing that equation. By automating complex servicing tasks and continuously identifying extra profit opportunities on existing bookings, we're helping agencies shift their focus from administration to selling, servicing customers and growing their businesses.
"We've spent more than a decade developing and refining this technology in corporate travel, one of the most demanding environments for booking management. Bringing that proven capability to the leisure sector represents a major growth opportunity for Oversee and a new way for travel agencies to improve their profitability."
The expansion builds on Oversee's established position in corporate travel, where its technology supports more than 11,000 customers across 60+ countries, including more than half of the Fortune 500.
Underpinned by more than 12 years of travel booking data, Oversee's AI-powered technology has optimised more than two million bookings and generated over $300 million in customer savings since 2014, while supporting more than $14 billion in annual booking volume.
The move marks a significant step in Oversee's growth strategy, extending its proven technology beyond corporate travel and opening up new opportunities across the global leisure travel industry.
For more information, visit: https://oversee.biz/
For further press information, please contact: Connor Jones | Annie Hopson | James Brooke Rooster. E: [email protected]
Oversee is an independent travel AI company that offers full-stack AI tools for travel agencies, covering the entire trip lifecycle from booking request to travel. Oversee helps travel businesses optimise bookings, reduce costs, improve margins and automate operations.
Founded in 2014, Oversee's modular technology suite includes AgentSee, FareSaver, HotelSaver and Travel Sourcing Optimisation, combining agentic AI, automated booking optimisation and sourcing analytics to help travel providers operate more efficiently and unlock additional revenue.
Oversee's technology supports more than 11,000 customers across 60+ countries, including more than 50% of the BTN 100 and dozens of leading global travel management companies.
For more information, visit https://oversee.biz/ .
